rationale: The plan correctly frames the question as an interaction, specifies ~genotype + treatment + genotype:treatment with WT and vehicle as reference levels, names the interaction coefficient, and adds the simple treatment effects within each genotype, with an appropriate warning against over-reading simple effects when the interaction is null and against the underpowered n=4/cell design. The main gap is QC: step 1 is only metadata alignment and cell-balance checking with a sensible catch of the 17-vs-16 column discrepancy, but there is no PCA, sample-distance heatmap, library-size inspection, or outlier policy. Normalization is only implicit (raw integer counts into DESeq2); size factors are never stated, though nothing pre-normalized is fed to the model. The low-count filter (>=10 counts in >=4 samples, tied to group size, with retained-gene reporting) is well judged, and BH at 0.05 is explicit, but the shrinkage handling is muddled — apeglm is listed then hedged, with no clear commitment to ashr for the interaction contrast when reporting effect sizes. Enrichment names collections and a ranking metric and sensibly flags small gene lists, but omits an ORA universe, collection versions, and a gene-set size window, and asserts human reference sets without establishing the organism; the report specifies design, thresholds, gene counts, and power caveats but not software versions.
